tasks.title: Extract a shared file-diff model and keep inline diff compatibility
tasks.description: Refactor the current diff parsing logic out of `DiffViewer` into a reusable utility or model layer that normalizes file blocks, hunks, line metadata, and derived counts such as changed-line totals. Keep the existing inline diff experiences working through a compatibility wrapper so later reader work can build on one parser instead of forking diff behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared diff-model utility can parse the current issue diff and commit diff patch formats into reusable file/hunk/line structures
Existing inline diff rendering in the issue detail Changes panel still works after the refactor
The shared model exposes enough metadata to support large-diff suppression and hunk navigation without re-parsing raw patch text in the page layer
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Expected touched files may include a new diff utility under packages/cli/web/src/lib or components plus a thinner DiffViewer wrapper. This task produces the shared parser/model consumed by every later reader task.

tasks.title: Add the changed-files page route and reader shell
tasks.description: Create the new `/issue/:number/files` route and page component with issue-aware loading, not-found, and unavailable states. The page should render the top reading context for issue number/title, base/head, files changed, additions/deletions, and current stage/status while staying free of approval, review, and merge-action UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to `/issue/:number/files` renders a dedicated changed-files page inside the existing Web UI router
The page shows issue number, title, base, head, files changed, additions, deletions, stage, and status when diff data is available
Not-started, worktree-removed, branch-missing, and other unavailable states render as reading-specific page states instead of crashing or showing issue-detail controls
The page does not show approve/reject actions, review reports, line comments, or merge decision UI
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Expected touched files include packages/cli/web/src/App.tsx and any small page-level helpers. Consume the shared diff model from T-001 instead of embedding new parsing logic in the page.

tasks.title: Implement the P0 file tree and unified diff reader
tasks.description: Add the main P0 reading experience inside the new page: a left-side changed-files tree grouped by directory, file-path filtering, and a right-side unified diff pane driven by the shared diff model. Include sticky file headers, expand all/collapse all controls, and large-diff suppression with a per-file `Render anyway` override so the page is optimized for reading rather than raw patch dumping.
acceptanceCriteria: The left pane groups changed files by directory instead of rendering a flat button list
Filtering by file path narrows the visible file tree and corresponding file selection behavior
The right pane renders unified diffs with line numbers and sticky file headers showing path, status, additions, and deletions
Expand all and collapse all controls work across the page reader state
Large diffs are hidden by default behind a placeholder with changed-line count and a Render anyway action
No file changes yet renders a clear empty state when an issue worktree exists but has no diff entries
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This is the core P0 reader capability. Prefer a dedicated component subtree for the page rather than growing ChangesPanel into the full reader.

tasks.title: Reduce Issue Detail to summary plus View files entry
tasks.description: Update `IssueDetailPage` so its Changes area becomes a lightweight entry point into the dedicated reader instead of the primary code-reading surface. Keep the existing summary context readable, add a `View files` navigation affordance, and preserve lightweight inline evidence only where it still supports issue management without competing with the new page.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue Detail shows a lightweight changes summary with base/head and diffstat context when available
Issue Detail provides a View files action that navigates to `/issue/:number/files`
The main code-reading workflow now lives on the dedicated page rather than requiring users to stay inside issue description/comments context
Issue Detail remains free of broken state after the routing change
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: This task consumes the dedicated page from T-002/T-003 and updates Issue Detail to coordinate navigation instead of owning the primary reader experience.

tasks.title: Add P1 reader controls for split diff, hunk navigation, scroll restore, and commit mode
tasks.description: Extend the reader shell so users can switch between unified and split diff, jump between hunks, resume their reading position after navigating away, and inspect file changes for a selected commit without leaving the dedicated reading surface. Reuse the existing issue commits and commit-diff APIs where possible, and keep the page focused on browsing evidence rather than introducing review decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: The reader supports unified and split diff modes without breaking the default unified reading flow
Prev hunk and next hunk controls navigate within the visible diff content
Leaving and returning to `/issue/:number/files` restores the last reading position for the same issue
Users can switch into a commit-scoped reading mode that uses existing commit data and still stays within the same reader shell
Commit mode does not introduce approval, review report, or merge decision UI
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use sessionStorage or equivalent reader-local persistence keyed by issue number. Reuse `/api/issues/:number/commits` and `/api/issues/:number/commits/:hash/diff` instead of designing a second commit reader API.

tasks.title: Add P2 raw, full-file, and in-diff search modes
tasks.description: Complete the advanced reading modes by adding raw patch view, full-file view with changed-line highlighting, and search within diff content. If full-file mode requires extra backend support to fetch file contents for base/head versions, add only the minimal API needed to serve the reader while keeping the route shape and page shell unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Each file supports a raw patch view suitable for copy/paste and format inspection
Each file supports a full-file view that highlights changed lines rather than showing only patch hunks
Users can search within the visible diff content and move through matches
Any backend support added for full-file mode is scoped to the changed-files reader and does not replace existing diff endpoints
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer additive API work only if full-file mode truly needs blob content from the backend. Keep the single reader shell from earlier tasks.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end regression coverage for the changed-files reader
tasks.description: Add focused automated coverage for the new changed-files reader so future UI or API refactors cannot silently regress the primary reading flow. Cover parser compatibility, route rendering, file tree/filter behavior, unified/split rendering, large-diff suppression, navigation from Issue Detail, and any advanced modes introduced by later tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover the dedicated route rendering and the View files navigation path from Issue Detail
Tests cover directory-grouped file tree behavior, file filtering, and large-diff Render anyway behavior
Tests cover unified diff rendering and any split/hunk/scroll-restore behavior added by the reader
If full-file or raw modes are implemented, tests cover at least one representative file-mode switch and visible output assertion
Existing relevant frontend and backend test suites pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Prefer the closest existing frontend test patterns in the repo. This task depends on the delivered user-facing reader behaviors rather than only implementation details.
